description: Defines the PartialTheme class in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding module. The class represents a partial view of a theme, capturing attributes like ID, name, variables, social media icon visibility, and filenames for client logos, banners, and login banners. It includes a factory method to create an instance from a Theme entity.

classes.name: PartialTheme
classes.description: Data Transfer Object representing a partial view of a theme, with attributes for identification, branding assets, and social media icon visibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all partial theme attributes with provided values.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the array of theme variables.

methods.name: showSocialMediaIcons
methods.description: Indicates whether social media icons should be displayed.

methods.name: getClientLogoFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client logo, if any.

methods.name: getClientBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client banner, if any.

methods.name: getLoginBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the login banner, if any.

methods.name: createFromTheme
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a Theme entity object.
